interview.hardest_part: Long-horizon Community Center planning and precise real-time actions, especially fishing and mining, under coarse 2-second action steps.
interview.likely_failure: Failing to establish an efficient early crop/water/sleep routine, then wasting the time budget on navigation, menus, energy management, or the fishing minigame before completing bundles.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Deterministic daily routines; starting parsnip seeds and 500 gold; shipping bin sales; quest journal and map; game pauses while thinking; progress saves on sleep.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Real-time fishing and combat with 2-second input granularity; energy and 2:00 am pass-out limits; long walks; weather/day/season constraints; multi-item bundle dependencies; dialogue and shop interactions requiring precise mouse clicks.
